create_self_distillation_trainer: create a BaseSelfDistillationTrainer with a model path, reward functions, and a train dataset for online self-distillation
build_vllm_generation: build a VLLMGeneration instance for accelerated rollout generation using vLLM with configurable tensor parallelism
configure_reward_functions: configure multiple reward functions with associated processing classes and weighted reward aggregation
prepare_peft_model: prepare a PEFT model with LoRA or other parameter-efficient fine-tuning configuration for self-distillation training
run_training_step: run a training step with buffered generation batches and online rollout for self-distillation optimization
